    # Split the two pattern halves around the vertical separator, then overlap them.

    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]

        row = []

            # Right pattern is shifted one cell left in the demonstrated alignment.
            b = c + 1 < len(right[r]) and right[r][c+1] != 0
            row.append(2 if a and b else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
